ios.desc:
Language Zen is like a personal tutor with a perfect memory.

It is proven to teach Spanish 2.2X more effectively than Rosetta Stone and can let you learn an entire semester of college level Spanish in 25 hours.

Language Zen is so effective because it adapts to every user. It detects your individual strengths and weaknesses to create a truly personalized experience.

We also data-mine real conversation to teach the things you're most likely to hear and use in the real world.

You can even learn with real music and dive into your personal interests, from travel to sports.


In short, Language Zen gives you:

-Language learning without frustration, personalized to you 

-Practical material from real conversation

-Specialized courses from shopping, to travel, to flirting, to sports

-Real music and songs to learn from


___________________________________________________________________

PLEASE NOTE

You will need a premium subscription in order to learn without taking mandatory breaks and to access all of this app's courses and music.

There are three main subscription options:

3 month subscription with 30 day trial for $35.99 USD (or the equivalent in local currency), automatically renewed until cancelled.

6 month subscription with 30 day trial for $59.99 USD (or the equivalent in local currency), automatically renewed until cancelled.

12 month subscription with 30 day trial for $95.99 USD (or the equivalent in local currency), automatically renewed until cancelled.

If you have already subscribed to one of the main plans, cancel and choose to resubscribe you will be offered comparable plans with the 30 day free trials.

Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current payment period.

Your iTunes account will be automatically charged at the same price for renewal within the 24-hour period prior to the end of the current payment period unless you change your subscription preferences in your Account Settings.

You can manage your subscriptions through your Account Settings after purchase.

Privacy policy: https://www.languagezen.com/privacy

Terms of Service: https://www.languagezen.com/premiumterms.aspx

quotes.text:
Backstory: my partner and I developed a language learning app that had some good traction around 2016, but we couldn’t raise enough money to build it out and market it further as much as we’d have liked, and since 2020 it’s largely been in hibernation.
We’re talking about diving back in and fundraising again, but are concerned the market has passed us by and, product wise, things may be too stacked against us, even if we raise money.
We have some unique approaches:
- In our main course, we data mine TV transcripts to teach people vocabulary in order of how likely they’ll be to encounter it.
- We built algorithms to track how well a user knows each meaning of a word. This allows us to prioritize teaching sentences that have the most words/grammatical concepts each specific user needs to practice, and it lets us teach through personalized spaced repetition.
- We let users learn from special topics and songs whenever they want. They can help bridge their personal vocabulary with the vocab of the course/song. For example, if you already know 50% of the words in a song that you’re interested in, we’ll teach you the 50% you don’t know so that you can understand all of it.
My real question is: is our actual user experience uniquely positive enough to differentiate us?
We built the app (Language Zen) to go up against Rosetta Stone, early Duolingo, Babbel and Busuu. Since then, Duolingo has advanced a lot, and there are new, interesting apps like Speak, Mondly, Lingvist and …
